statement.zh: 阿玛尔纳 1926–1932 年北郊与沙漠祭坛结果见 Frankfort & Pendlebury《阿肯那顿之城》II（1933）。
statement.en: At Amarna, 1926–1932 results for the North Suburb and desert altars are documented in Frankfort & Pendlebury City of Akhenaten II (1933).
